ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels to 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad contiguous white regions occupy the central-medial portions of both lobes. These are bounded by thick, irregular black margins along the trailing edge and tips. A dark, roughly triangular pigmentation zone extends from the peduncle base into the center of the fluke, tapering toward the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior pixel angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits several high-amplitude, jagged indentations (notches) that deviate from the more uniform fine-grained serrations visible on the distal half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a distinct convex sweep, curving posteriorly before tapering to narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible across the white field of the left lobe, particularly concentrated toward the medial margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the white ventral surface of the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and deep notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating historical tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive dark 'Y' shaped pigmentation pattern at the base of the fluke where the lobes meet the peduncle.
